description: She wears a floor-length deep burgundy gown with a straight square neckline and narrow gold-edged shoulder straps. Gold and dark embroidered bands border the neckline and run vertically down the front. An ornate gold belt with oval plaques and hanging ornaments defines the waist. The front opening reveals an opaque cream underdress; a mauve shawl with gold embroidered borders rests around her upper arms and falls at both sides. A small round pendant, delicate earrings and a gold wrist cuff complete the outfit. An embroidered brown-gold closed shoe is visible below the hem.
